description.value: The Maple Ridge Public Library is a branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library system, serving the Maple Ridge community with a full range of lending, digital, and programming services. It is a publicly accessible civic facility located in a unit at 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road in central Maple Ridge. Touring cyclists may find it a useful urban stop for rest and connectivity, though specific cycling amenities are unconfirmed.
